meaning:
ἀνοια, -ας, ἡ
(ἄ-νοος, without understanding), [in LXX: Pro.14:8, 2215 (אִוֶּלֶת), Wis.15:18, al. ;]
folly, foolishness: 2Ti.3:9; expressed in violent rage (cf. Plat., Tim., 86B): Luk.6:11.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: But they were filled with rage, and talked with one another about what they might do to Jesus.
But they will proceed no further. For their folly will be evident to all men, as theirs also came to be.
